heading: Disenrollment
lead: Members of the Auxiliary may be disenrolled pursuant to applicable regulations.

notes.heading: Historical and Revision Notes
notes.text: Experience has shown that it is desirable to have a statute definitely providing for separation of Auxiliarists from the organization. 81st Congress, House Report No. 557.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2018—Pub. L. 115–282 renumbered section 824 of this title as this section.
